scope: Fail-closed retained-frame accounting for GEODATA, RASTERVARIABLES and WIPEOUTVARIABLES; no legacy source admission.
change: A shared generation-filtered frame counter recognizes a family by either class name, record alias or matching published numeric CLASS id. An incomplete CLASS report can no longer be treated as an empty family when a retained frame identifies the family. Existing proxy and source-profile refusals are retained.

validation.fastCTest: six selected raster/wipeout adapter and CLI tests pass, including named-class/record-alias refusal, previous-generation isolation and corrected retry
validation.classNumber: a generated typed GEODATA source tests an extra differently named raw frame with the same CLASS id; preflight rejects it and succeeds after removal
validation.negativeBaseline: the new family-name and CLASS-number controls fail against unchanged baseline production code as expected
validation.baselineGeodataIssue: the full GEODATA round-trip test fails later at the strict AC1027 source-reference guard on both the unchanged base and this branch; the focused preflight selector isolates the new check
validation.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: three selected raster/wipeout adapter tests passed, including the shared family and GEODATA preflight controls

limitations: This counter covers retained opaque callbacks, not a complete physical class-number census for every object-map frame.
It does not authorize an unused proxy CLASS, legacy layout projection, or claim native AutoCAD compatibility.
The unchanged strict AC1027 test conflict remains a separate plan item.
